title_en: Marvel Pits Some of the World's Most Dangerous Heroes Against Frank Castle in Punisher Showdowns
summary_en: Two of the deadliest killers in the Marvel Universe collide in this exclusive preview of Punisher Showdowns: Black Widow #1.
body_en:
Frank Castle tends to operate in his own, bloody corner of the Marvel Universe, but sometimes it's fun to see what happens when he's pitted against members of Marvel's superhero community. That's pretty much the thinking behind Punisher Showdowns, a new series of one-shot specials that pair Frank with other dangerous characters like Black Widow, Wolverine, and the Winter Soldier.
IGN can exclusively debut a new preview of Punisher Showdowns: Black Widow #1. Get a closer look in the slideshow gallery below:
Tom Waltz (TMNT: The Last Ronin) is the writer of all the Punisher Showdowns issues, with Greg Land (Uncanny X-Men) handling art and Rachelle Rosenberg (Astonishing X-Men) providing colors on the Black Widow chapter. Here's Marvel's official summary for Punisher Showdowns: Black Widow #1:
Future chapters of the series include Punisher Showdowns: Wolverine #1 by Waltz and Bruno Büll and Punisher Showdowns: Winter Soldier #1 by Waltz and Edgar Salazar.
Punisher Showdowns: Black Widow #1 will be released on October 21. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
For more, check out our exclusive interview about the upcoming finale of Star Trek: The Last Starship and see a bleak preview of The Amazing Spider-Man #1000 .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
